name: pulse-range
title: Pulse Range
description: The day's heart rate as a glowing range: a capsule slides to the latest reading, its heart beating at that rate.

perf.budget: The capsule moves on a UI-thread spring on change. The heart is one view on a UI-thread loop, so it animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The capsule jumps to its place, the heart holds still and the number does not count.
a11y.screenReader: One label ("Heart rate 112 beats per minute. TODAY average 74, low 52, high 168. JUST NOW.").

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { PulseRange } from '@/components/kinetik/pulse-range';

<PulseRange bpm={112} min={52} max={168} average={74} ago="JUST NOW" />;
```

## When to use

- A heart rate summary in a health or workout app.
- Any reading best shown between today's low and high.

## When not to use

- Medical decisions: this is a summary, not a monitor.
- Readings with no meaningful range.

## Notes

- The heart beats at `bpm`, kept between 30 and 200 so odd readings cannot make it flicker.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add pulse-range`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
